caption: The drawing is set on a bright yellow background with a gray rectangular border. It features a central scene composed of distinctly outlined pink and white figures with black details. On the left side of the image, there is a large animal, likely a wild boar, depicted in pink and outlined in black, running to the left with its front legs extended and mouth open. Above the boar, there is a leaping animal, likely a deer or hare, also in pink with black outlining. To the right, a human figure wearing attire suggestive of a hunt, also in pink, is riding a galloping horse. The horse is in mid-leap, heading to the right, and the rider is holding a black spear pointed towards the boar. Below the horse, two hounds, rendered in pink, are running in the same direction as the horse. The ground under the figures is indicated with pink and black lines and shapes resembling grass and clusters of flowers in white, yellow, and pink. Light white decorative branches and floral motifs are in the background, filling the spaces around the central action.
title: Bandbox Design - Hunting Scene
